q: What is the Young Pro Ministry?
Ano ang FTB Young Pro Ministry?
a_en: FTB Young Pro is the Young Professionals Ministry of Faith Temple Baptist Church Inc. — a warm, faith-centered community of Filipino young professionals who worship God and make disciples together. We meet for YP Fellowship and monthly hangouts (YPGT), so faith and real friendships grow side by side.
a_tl: Ang FTB Young Pro ay ang Young Professionals Ministry ng Faith Temple Baptist Church Inc. — isang warm at faith-centered na community ng mga Pinoy young professionals na sama-samang sumasamba sa Diyos at gumagawa ng disciples. May YP Fellowship kami at monthly hangouts (YPGT), para magkasabay lumago ang faith at totoong pagkakaibigan.

q: Ano ang ibig sabihin ng YP?
Anong short for ng Young Pro?
a_en: YP means Young Pro / Young Professionals. A few acronyms you'll see: YPF = YP Fellowship (our regular worship + the Word gathering), YPGT = Young Pro Get-Together (our monthly outing), and FTBCI = Faith Temple Baptist Church Inc., the church we belong to.
a_tl: Ang YP ay ibig sabihin Young Pro / Young Professionals. Ilang acronyms na makikita mo: YPF = YP Fellowship (regular worship + the Word namin), YPGT = Young Pro Get-Together (monthly outing namin), at FTBCI = Faith Temple Baptist Church Inc., ang church na kinabibilangan namin.

keywords: are you a community for professionals
community ba ito para sa professionals
q: Are you a community for young professionals?
Is this a group for professionals?
Para ba ito sa mga young professionals?
Grupo ba kayo para sa mga professionals?
Is this a fellowship for working professionals?
a_en: Yes! We are a Christian community and fellowship for young professionals — built for working Filipinos who want to grow in faith alongside their careers. Whether you're fresh out of school, navigating your first job, or already deep into your field, there's a seat for you here.
a_tl: Oo! Kami ay isang Christian community at fellowship para sa mga young professionals — para sa mga nagtatrabahong Pinoy na gustong lumago sa faith kasabay ng career. Kahit fresh grad ka pa lang, nasa unang trabaho, o malalim na sa field mo — may upuan ka rito.

q: What church is Young Pro under?
Is Young Pro a separate church?
Department ba kayo ng Faith Temple?
a_en: Young Pro isn't a separate church — we're a ministry (department) of Faith Temple Baptist Church Inc. (FTBCI). We're the young professionals' arm of the church family, focused on faith, discipleship, and friendship in the marketplace.
a_tl: Hindi hiwalay na church ang Young Pro — kami ay isang ministry (department) ng Faith Temple Baptist Church Inc. (FTBCI). Kami ang young professionals' arm ng church family, naka-focus sa faith, discipleship, at pagkakaibigan sa marketplace.

q: What is the heart of Young Pro?
Ano ang misyon o layunin niyo?
a_en: Our heart is simple: Worship God. Make Disciples. We want young professionals to know Jesus, grow deep in faith, and live it out boldly in their careers and friendships. Faith and excellence in the marketplace — that's the goal.
a_tl: Simple lang ang heart namin: Worship God. Make Disciples. Gusto naming makilala ng mga young pro si Jesus, lumalim sa faith, at ipamuhay ito nang buo sa trabaho at pakikipagkaibigan. Faith at excellence sa marketplace — yan ang goal.

q: Pwede ba ako sumali kahit hindi pa christian?
a_en: Young Pro is for Filipino young professionals — students stepping into work, fresh grads, and those already building their careers. You don't have to be a church member or even a Christian yet; come as you are. Curious if you fit? Message us at ftb.youngpro.ministry@gmail.com.
a_tl: Ang Young Pro ay para sa mga Pinoy young professionals — papasok pa lang sa trabaho, fresh grads, o yung nasa career na. Hindi mo kailangan maging church member o kahit Christian pa; come as you are. Curious kung bagay ka? Message mo lang kami sa ftb.youngpro.ministry@gmail.com.

q: Ano ang special sa Young Pro?
Ano ang pinag-iiba niyo sa ibang ministry?
a_en: We blend real faith with real Filipino culture and friendships. Our fellowship topics walk through heart-deep Filipino themes — Loob, Kapwa, Malasakit, Bahala Na, and Utang na Loob — through a Christian lens, while our YPGT outings (coffee, swimming, museum tours, food) build genuine kabarkada bonds. Reverent but fun, never corporate.
a_tl: Pinagsasama namin ang totoong faith sa totoong Pinoy culture at pagkakaibigan. Ang mga fellowship topics namin ay dumadaan sa malalim na Pinoy themes — Loob, Kapwa, Malasakit, Bahala Na, at Utang na Loob — through a Christian lens, habang ang YPGT outings (kape, swimming, museum tours, kainan) ay bumubuo ng tunay na kabarkada bonds. Reverent pero masaya, hindi corporate.

q: Where and when does Young Pro meet?
a_en: We gather at the FTB Auditorium — #206 P. Orbe St., Blueville Subdivision, Novaliches, Quezon City. Our YP Fellowship is usually at 2:30 PM on the 2nd or 3rd week of the month, plus a monthly YPGT outing. Want the exact next date? Email ftb.youngpro.ministry@gmail.com or check Happenings.
a_tl: Nagtitipon kami sa FTB Auditorium — #206 P. Orbe St., Blueville Subdivision, Novaliches, Quezon City. Ang YP Fellowship namin ay kadalasan 2:30 PM tuwing 2nd o 3rd week ng buwan, plus monthly YPGT outing. Gusto mo ng eksaktong susunod na petsa? Email mo kami sa ftb.youngpro.ministry@gmail.com o tingnan ang Happenings.

keywords: commit your work to the lord
q: What Bible verse does Young Pro stand on?
a_en: Our anchor verse is Proverbs 16:3 — "Commit your work to the Lord, and your plans will be established." It captures who we are: young professionals giving our work and dreams to God. That's the heart behind "Faith & Excellence in the Marketplace."
a_tl: Ang anchor verse namin ay Kawikaan (Proverbs) 16:3 — "Commit your work to the Lord, and your plans will be established." Ito ang kumakatawan kung sino kami: mga young professionals na ibinibigay ang trabaho at pangarap sa Diyos. Yan ang heart sa likod ng "Faith & Excellence in the Marketplace."

q: Sino ang mga leaders ng Young Pro?
a_en: Young Pro is led by Pastor Jaymar Bagalacsa (PJB), our Young Pro Pastor and Department Head, together with core leaders Kuya Darcy (Darcy Amiel Sudiacal), Cess (Princess Jean Laborte), and Ryan (Ryan James Indangan). They shepherd, teach, and serve the ministry together.
a_tl: Pinamumunuan ang Young Pro ni Pastor Jaymar Bagalacsa (PJB), ang Young Pro Pastor at Department Head namin, kasama ang core leaders na sina Kuya Darcy (Darcy Amiel Sudiacal), Cess (Princess Jean Laborte), at Ryan (Ryan James Indangan). Sila ang nag-aalaga, nagtuturo, at naglilingkod sa ministry.

q: Is YP the same as Young Pro and Young Professionals?

Ibang tawag ba ang YP at Young Pro?
a_en: Yes — YP, Young Pro, Young Professionals, and Young Pro Ministry all refer to the same family: the Young Professionals Ministry of Faith Temple Baptist Church Inc. Different nicknames, same warm community.
a_tl: Oo — ang YP, Young Pro, Young Professionals, at Young Pro Ministry ay iisa lang: ang Young Professionals Ministry ng Faith Temple Baptist Church Inc. Iba-ibang palayaw, pero iisang mainit na community.
